name: smwmusic-crash-nitro-kart-out-of-time
title: Crash Nitro Kart - Out of Time
description:
A fast paced theme that plays in Out of Time, one of the most iconic tracks from Crash Nitro Kart, being set in a desert with clockwork buildings and a giant clock you drive on (which was unfortunately removed in the remake due to the lack of anti-gravity).

You can define in the .txt file which variation you want to use:
0 - Default in-game version
1 - Extended OST version (3:16, 0x0F48)

Note: The OST version of this song is incompatible with thunder, blargg and Yoshi sound effects and the vanilla bonus end jingle.
